subject: Invite: EchoHealth customer roundtable at RealWorld Inference Summit
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@echohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Invite: EchoHealth customer roundtable at RealWorld Inference Summit

Hi Elena,

Quick note — Redwood is organizing a short customer roundtable at our RealWorld Inference Summit (Feb 2027). We’d love to have EchoHealth on a 30-minute panel focusing on how you’ve put private deployments into production for patient-facing workflows. Your story about privacy controls and latency optimizations would resonate with other healthcare teams.

High-level format: 3 customers, 30 minutes, moderated Q&A, 10–12 minute customer segment each. We offer travel stipend and a co-marketing blog + case study afterwards.

Can you let me know if EchoHealth might be interested? If so I’ll loop in Marketing to get logistics and a brief MAP going. I attached a one-page speaker brief with dates and expectations.

Thanks — really hope you can join.

Connor Obrien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: RWIS-2027-speaker-brief.pdf (1 page - event overview)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@echohealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Samir Patel <samir.patel@echohealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invite: EchoHealth customer roundtable at RealWorld Inference Summit

Hi Connor — thanks for reaching out and for the invite. This sounds like a great fit for EchoHealth. I’ve looped in Samir (VP of Engineering) because he’d likely be the one presenting. Two quick asks before we commit:

- Can you share the panel moderator questions and the high-level talking points you expect?
- Our legal/compliance team will need the speaker agreement and confirmation that no PHI will be displayed or shared during the session.

I cc’d Samir so he’s aware. If you can send the MAP and agreement, we’ll review internally and confirm by early next week.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, EchoHealth
elena.ruiz@echohealth.com
Attachment: Elena-bio.pdf (sent separately)

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@echohealth.com>, Dr. Samir Patel <samir.patel@echohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invite: EchoHealth customer roundtable at RealWorld Inference Summit

Elena / Samir — great, thanks. Attaching the speaker agreement and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out timelines: slide deck deadline, bio, headshot, and compliance checklist. Moderator themes are appended to the speaker brief but key topics we’d like EchoHealth to cover are: private deployment choices, latency/cost trade-offs, and SOC2/compliance posture.

No PHI or identifiable patient data will be allowed on stage — we’ll confirm in the agreement. If legal has minor redlines, we can accept an addendum; our events legal is used to standard vendor/partner edits.

Next steps suggestion:
- Sign speaker agreement (DocuSign link below)
- Confirm speaker name(s) and 2–3 bullets for the moderator by 2026-12-08
- Provide headshot and logo by 2026-12-15

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/echohealth/signer/ABCD1234
Attachment: speaker-agreement-echohealth.pdf, echohealth-MAP-draft.xlsx

Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): speaker-agreement-echohealth.pdf, echohealth-MAP-draft.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@echohealth.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invite: EchoHealth customer roundtable at RealWorld Inference Summit — logistics

Hi Elena / Samir — Marissa from Marketing here. Welcome and so glad EchoHealth is open to participating. A few logistics and asks so we can get this on the calendar: 

1) Moderator questions (we’ll tailor but examples included in the attached speaker brief).
2) Prefered speaker (Samir or an engineering lead?) and a 2–3 sentence bio.
3) Headshot (square 1200px) and company logo (PNG).
4) Quick approval on co-marketing: a short case-study blog post and a recorded clip for social. If you want to opt out of any co-marketing, tell us now.

We created a shared folder where you can drop assets: https://docs.redwood.ai/shared/drive/RWIS-2027/EchoHealth-Assets

I attached a draft MAP (timeline) for internal tracking. If the dates look tight we can adjust. Also tagging Monica from CS to advise on technical slide suggestions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: echohealth-MAP-draft.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@echohealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@echohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invite: EchoHealth customer roundtable at RealWorld Inference Summit — technical bullets

Hi all — Monica from Customer Success. Congrats and huge +1 from our side. For the 10–12 minute customer window, customers and the audience love 3 focused slides:

- Slide 1: Problem statement & why inference matters for the workflow (1–2 bullets)
- Slide 2: Architecture overview (where Redwood sits, private VPC details, key latency numbers)
- Slide 3: Outcome & metrics (cost per inference, latency percentile, compliance milestones)

If Samir wants to hand off to an engineer for the architecture slide, that’s perfectly fine. Also happy to run a 30-minute prep call to rehearse and turn your bullets into speaker notes.

I’ve also added a brief checklist for compliance notes we typically include in the MC script — confirm you’re comfortable with those and we’ll omit anything flagged.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@echohealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invite: EchoHealth customer roundtable at RealWorld Inference Summit — logistics

Thanks everyone — we reviewed the agreement and Samir is happy to present. I signed the DocuSign this afternoon (link above) and uploaded our headshot and a short bio to the shared folder. A couple quick notes:

- We will not share any logs or outputs containing PHI on stage; slides will use synthetic examples.
- Samir will take the architecture slide; he asked for a 30-minute prep call the week of 2027-01-09 to align on talking points.

I’ll mark the MAP dates in our calendar. Looking forward to working with you — please send the prep invite and moderator questions when ready.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, EchoHealth
elena.ruiz@echohealth.com
Attachment: Elena-bio.pdf
